snippet.title: Gotham Knights - Official Cinematic Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Knights are not just sidekicks, replacements, or imitations. They are everything their predecessor taught them and so much more. The Gotham Knights are Gotham’s future.

#GothamKnights 

Pre-order Gotham Knights and get the 233 Kustom Batcycle Skin.

Learn more: http://go.wbgames.com/GothamKnights
